page.layout: One page of text in a single column; no marginal notes. The faint fragments at the far left edge belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: quomodo quoq; Heraclius Heraclij Imperatoris pater à Philippico ad hostium speculationem emis-sus, mirificè sit seruatus, deq; Zaberta Persa, & quomodo à Chlomarorum oppugnatione destiterint Romani. adhæc etiam de magna turpiq; fuga Philippici, turbatoq; ordinc[?] in cducendo[?] exercitu Romano. ac de morbo qui Philippicum inuaserat. & quòd Heraclius Heraclij Imperatoris pater curam ducatus in se susceperit quomodoque in Meridionalem Mediam irruptionem fecerit Romanæ militiæ subimperator. & ut verno tempore in Persarum ordines irruerint Romani. Comprehenditur quoq; libro hoc uti Comentiolus in Abaros expeditione duxerit, subimperatores habens Marinum & Captum. & quam strenuè se habuerint illi contra Abaros, postea vero vivo uterq; captus, quodq; Anfimuth duce peditum Romanorum ab Abaris capto eius postea exercitus per Thraciam excursiones secerit. & Comentioli consultatio an oporteret adriri Abaros, & habita concio super invadendis Abaris, & concioni isti concio opposita. quomodo rumor illapsus in exercitum barbarorum, irritum Comentioli fecerit contra Chaganum consilium. item de Busa milite, & quomodo dum venarctur deprehensus sit ab Abaris, & quomodo à 9. manipularibus suis per contemptum neglectus, primus ideò Abaros obsidionalia instrumenta fabricare docuerit. & quomodo abs Chagano obsessa Beroe, conatus non successerit. sic quomodo Diocletiani urbem idem ipse obsidens, & in hoc casu frustra fuerit. & quomodo Mauricius Imperator à communi Byzantiorum vulgo ludibrio habitus,

page.notes: Left edge: fragments of the neighbouring page, left out. Several letters are doubtful at the scan: "ordinc" and "cducendo" (line 6) are unclear; "sit" and "seruatus" were read with long s and may be "fit"/"feruatus" as printed. The ruled marks of the scan (show-through and the edge of the adjacent page) are not transcribed. "Chlomarorum", "Anfimuth" and "Busa" are as far as legible; the printed text "Comentioli" and "Abaris" are kept as printed. Last word "propter" is a catchword at the right foot.
